title: BLIND: Bias Removal With No Demographics

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance gaps (e.g., True Positive Rate and False Positive Rate gaps) and statistical fairness metrics (Independence, Separation, Sufficiency) on a sentiment classification task using tweets written in African American English (AAE) versus Mainstream US English (MUSE).
Evaluating performance gaps and statistical fairness metrics on an occupation classification task using a dataset of professional biographies containing binary gender pronouns.
